title: Helm upgrade failing
body:
Upgrading from 1.16.0 to 1.19.1:
`UPGRADE FAILED: cannot patch "weaviate" with kind StatefulSet: StatefulSet.apps "weaviate" is invalid: spec: Forbidden: updates to statefulset spec for fields other than 'replicas', 'template', 'updateStrategy', 'persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy' and 'minReadySeconds' are forbidden`

The error does not mention which statefulset field has been changed in the newest release...

(Related to #2556 )

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Which version of Helm are you using? the latest version is [v16.3.0](https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate-helm/releases/tag/v16.3.0)

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: I'm using chart v16.3.0.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
My script:

```
#!/bin/bash

# Set the Weaviate chart version
export CHART_VERSION="v16.3.0"
# Download the Weaviate Helm chart
wget -O downloads/weaviate.tgz https://github.com/semi-technologies/weaviate-helm/releases/download/$CHART_VERSION/weaviate.tgz
# Download an example values.yml (with the default configuration)
wget -O downloads/values.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/semi-technologies/weaviate-helm/$CHART_VERSION/weaviate/values.yaml

######################### GCloud login ################################
gcloud container clusters get-credentials weaviate-1 --region europe-west1 --project weaviate-374814
######################### GCloud login ################################

# set the desired Weaviate version
export WEAVIATE_VERSION="1.19.4"

# set the desired namespace
export K8S_NAMESPACE="wpsolr-prod"

# Deploy
helm upgrade \
  "weaviate" \
  downloads/weaviate.tgz \
  --install \
  --namespace "$K8S_NAMESPACE" \
  --create-namespace \
  --values downloads/values.yaml \
  --values values-wpsolr-prod.yaml \
  --set "image.tag=$WEAVIATE_VERSION"

```

comments.body:
You didn't change anything in your `values.yaml` yes?

Looks like helm is adding extra settings to `StatefulSet` which is forbidden when doing updates (look this issue [here](https://github.com/helm/helm/issues/7998)) It might be connected to the changes that we made. Do you happen to remember which version of helm charts you used before?

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
@reporter in `v16.x.x` we have introduced new setting in `Statefulset` (`serviceAccountName`) and this change is producing this error. In this situation in order to successfully perform upgrade you need to delete `Statefulset` (this operation will not delete the data, only the `Statefulset`) and after the delete you can re-run the `helm command` it should be successful then.

TL;DR;
1. remove Statefulset
```
kubectl -n wpsolr-prod delete statefulsets.apps weaviate
```
2. re-run your deployment script
